protocol: Render one lightweight HumanML3D-style skeleton MP4 per Original100 full-text prompt for leftmost GT reference.
motion_source: HumanML3D new_joints files from hml_original100_sample_manifest.tsv gt_motion_path.
coverage: Original100 GT diagnostic visualization; 100 prompts when limit=0.
limitations: Skeleton visualization for qualitative inspection only; not a held-out final evaluator; uses the same Matplotlib-compatible MoMask/HumanML3D-style renderer and first-frame nonblank skeleton validation.
